name: VAP-Data
description: The largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions, covering concept (entity transformation and interaction), style, motion (human and non-human), and camera movement categories.

creator.name: Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance and The Chinese University of Hong Kong

citeAs: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu. Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv:2510.20888v1, 2025.
rai:dataCollection: We curated 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases. We then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images collected from the Internet, covering diverse subjects including men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Reference images were matched to compatible Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to generate paired videos. Some templates restrict subject categories, so not all images were matched to all templates.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos were resized to 480×720 (832) resolution and sampled at 49 frames at 16fps following pre-trained DiT specifications.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models using visual effects templates from commercial models (VIDU, Kling) and community LoRAs. Paired videos were created by applying semantic condition templates to reference images.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: VIDU, Kling (commercial models), community LoRAs for video generation
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes reference images of men, women, children, and diverse human subjects across different demographics.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media. The work is intended for research, education, and creative prototyping only, not for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates (e.g., if the source models are poor at generating hands, VAP will likely not learn to generate hands well from this data).
rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models. The dataset may inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates. Performance depends on caption quality and structural similarity between main subjects: it is stable when caption styles align and subjects are similar, but degrades when descriptions diverge or when subjects differ markedly. Building a large, real-world, semantic-controlled video dataset would help address these issues but is beyond the paper's main focus.
rai:dataUseCases: Training: The dataset is used to train the Video-As-Prompt (VAP) model for unified semantic-controlled video generation across multiple semantic conditions including concept, style, motion, and camera control. Testing: For evaluation, 24 semantic conditions were evenly sampled from 4 categories (concept, style, motion, camera) in the test subset, with 2 samples each, totaling 48 test samples. The work is released with a research-only license and acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios. Default content filters block clearly harmful categories (e.g., sexual content, explicit violence, hate symbols).
